snippet.title: The Hambagu Shop - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
The Hambagu Shop launches on Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch on January 11, 2027.

Run a Japanese Hamburg steak restaurant, serve delicious meals, grow your business, and uncover the disturbing secrets hiding behind its cozy atmosphere.

The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where everyday restaurant life slowly turns into something far more unsettling.
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
